deadline.value: Applications close December 15, 2026 (the page gives the day and month; the year comes from the Graduate School's Fall 2027 statement).
deadline.quote: Admissions is an annual process, with an application deadline of December 15.

also.quote: While the application is for Fall 2027 enrollment, all associated deadlines fall within the 2026 calendar year (e.g., November 15, 2026)

gre_general.value: The General and Physics GRE are optional, and the page says there are no cut-offs.

funding.value: Only the Horizon Fellowship's sixth year is described as guaranteed; no general funding rule is stated.
funding.quote: It provides an additional (sixth) year of guaranteed financial support.

entry_route.value: The page does not state whether applicants come straight from a bachelor's degree.

notes: The page was last updated January 22, 2022, within five years. The Graduate School fields-of-study page for astrophysical sciences is blocked (403).
